feeds.title: Autism Association of Western Australia News
feeds.description: The Autism Association of Western Australia is one of Australia's largest not-for-profit Autism specific service providers, driven by the mission to advance the personal development, equality of opportunity, and community participation of people with Autism. The Autism Association of Western Australia is committed to quality service.

feeds.title: Amaze
feeds.description: Amaze is an organization, formed for supporting autistic individuals and their families. Amaze builds autism understanding in the community, influences policy change for autistic people, and provides independent, credible information and resources to individuals, families, professionals, the government, and the wider community. Amaze's role is to ensure the voices of autistic people and their families are heard and their needs met.

feeds.title: Autism Advisory And Support Service Blog
feeds.description: Find the latest news and research related to Autism spectrum disorders. Autism Advisory and Support Service (AASS) is a non-profit charity run for children and adults with Autism spectrum disorders and their families. AASS aims to empower children and adults with Autism and their families through knowledge and support. Our team of dedicated professionals uses an evidence-based, collaborative, and holistic approach to service delivery.

feeds.title: Reframing Autism Blog
feeds.description: Discover articles related to Autsim disorder. Reframing Autism is run by & for Autistic people & their families & allies. At Reframing Autism, we are dedicated to creating a world in which the Autistic community is supported to achieve acceptance, inclusion & active citizenship. Ultimately, our goal is to improve long-term Autistic mental health and well-being.

feeds.title: Australasian Society For Autism Research News
feeds.description: At the Australasian Society For Autism Research (ASfAR), we are here to provide a community for researchers who have a focus on Autism. ASfAR's mission is to support research, improve the lives of those with Autism, and assist and advocate on behalf of researchers working in the domain of Autism.

feeds.title: Autism Swim Blog
feeds.description: Autism Swim is the international peak body for inclusive aquatics. We specialize in wandering and drowning prevention for those on the autism spectrum and with any specific learning needs. The organization, combines the expertise of autism specialists, behavior specialists, occupational therapists, and Swimming Instructors to achieve the best possible outcomes for the individuals whom they support.

feeds.title: Living on The Spectrum Blog
feeds.description: Keep up to date with Autism resources in Australia. Living on the Spectrum is an Australian Autism directory and Neurodiversity hub. We list inclusive resources, products, and events for the neurodivergent community. We have information for carers, parents, adults, educators, researchers, businesses, and anyone wanting to learn more about autism and neurodiversity.

feeds.title: Parenting Autism In Adelaide
feeds.description: Hi Everyone, my name is Ryan. My family lives in Adelaide Australia. My son has nonverbal Autism Level 3 with Global Delay. This blog is about the journey that is not just about being a father to an Autistic child. I hope to help other families going through a similar experience that we are experiencing, with my blog.

feeds.title: The Spectrum Blog
feeds.description: The blog section will provide extensive knowledge on Autism. The Spectrum is an Autism SA initiative. We embrace neurodiversity and are curious about exploring and understanding how different ways of thinking can shape us, our communities, and our world. We aim for The Spectrum to reflect our commitment to community and inclusion.

feeds.title: Curtin Autism Research Group Blog
feeds.description: Read all about the current news, events, and research happening at Curtin Autism Research Group (CARG). Curtin is an internationally focused research and teaching university. CARG has a team of people on the autism spectrum, researchers, students, and volunteers who are dedicated to finding evidence-based, innovative, and effective approaches to supporting individuals on the autism spectrum and their families, at all stages in life.

feeds.title: Sydney Autism Community Lions Club News
feeds.description: Sydney Autism Community Lions Club is dedicated to the advancement and empowerment of people on the autism spectrum. We are an inclusive club and support network, and seek to provide an environment that promotes acceptance, support, friendship, and connection for our members and community.

feeds.title: Learning Ready Behaviour Services Blog
feeds.description: Our blog has a collection of topics relevant to Autism.

feeds.title: Sue Larkey Blog
feeds.description: Sue Larkey is a highly qualified educator who has taught students with an autism spectrum disorder in mainstream and special schools. She believes that armed with the tools of understanding and confidence, much can be achieved. Here she will give tips, teaching strategies, behavior strategies, social skills, understandings, and inspiration to help make difference for a child with Autism Spectrum Disorders in your class, home, or community.

feeds.title: The Everyday Autism Series Blog
feeds.description: The Everyday Autism Series Blog has a collection of topics related to the Austin spectrum disorder. The Everyday Autism series was started for helping kids and adults with Austin spectrum disorder. Books in this series include pictures and illustrations and are presented with the hope that they would raise awareness and understanding of the growing reality of autism.
